# Agent Preflight

Agent Preflight is a deterministic code safety gate for Python and JavaScript.

- URL: https://artist-outcome-habitat-rider.trycloudflare.com
- Detects: eval, exec, compile, subprocess, os.system, os.popen, child_process, new Function, hardcoded secrets, unsafe deserialization
- API key auth

Use this before executing code generated by an LLM.
